verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gateway access control and per-tool enable/disable on hosted servers, plus a bearer key for the directory API. Nothing documents issuing API credentials whose scope or privileges can be limited for an agent. Per-tool toggles and Gateway credential management are adjacent controls, not scoped credential issuance, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
